product.olivetti-notebook-s25-c.summary: The S25/C added passive-matrix colour to the Olivetti 1. Notebook range.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25-c.history: MCmicrocomputer documented the S25/C in May 1992, with availability expected at the end of summer. It was the colour S25 in the Olivetti 1. line.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25-c.architec: The display distinguished the versions. In November, MCmicrocomputer described the same 386SX base, 80 MB disk and VGA compatibility with different panels.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25-c.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25-c.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
